name: What types of gutters are available for installation?
description: Common gutter types include aluminum, steel, copper, and vinyl, each offering different benefits in terms of durability, cost, and appearance.

mainEntity.name: What types of gutters are available for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common gutter materials include aluminum, steel, copper, and vinyl. Aluminum is a popular choice for its affordability and durability. Steel gutters offer strength and can withstand harsh weather but may be prone to rust without proper coating. Copper gutters are highly durable and develop a distinctive patina over time, though they are a premium option. Vinyl gutters are cost-effective and easy to install but generally less durable than metal options. Each material has different lifespans, maintenance requirements, and aesthetic qualities.
